g.text: Shaded = gap between LightGBM and N-HiTS Huber. Dotted lines = forecast origins. WMAPE = sum of absolute errors / sum of actual sales; |bias| = |total forecast / total actual - 1|.

text.style: fill: #555555; font: 7.5px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: Example chosen by rule: largest error advantage of the first setting in the segment, among series selling at least the median weekly volume in history, with no

text.style: fill: #555555; font: 7.5px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: run of 13+ zero weeks (off the shelf or out of stock), with no run of 4+ zero weeks and no week under 10% of the series' median weekly sales (history or

text.style: fill: #555555; font: 7.5px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: forecast weeks) and at least 52 weeks of history.

text.style: fill: #555555; font: 7.5px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: FOODS_1_218_TX_2 is rank 1 of 167 candidates. 1,257 of 2,160 series (58%) show this pattern.

text.style: fill: #555555; font: 7.5px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: Over all 2,019 series with >50 units: 11 improved by >20% of their error, 50 got worse by as much.
